recentItems.title: Dakar 2026: Khaby Lame on Senegal’s historic Youth Olympic Games and inspiration from Usain Bolt
recentItems.description:
As the historic Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games - the first Olympic event on African soil - reaches its midpoint, host Bright Ofosu Larbi reflects on the top highlights from the Opening Ceremony and a thrilling first week of action alongside guests Kobe Boujee and Nischal Schwager-Patel. Plus, hear what global ambassador and social media icon Khaby Lame had to say about bringing the Games to his home country.

recentItems.description:
Teaming up with Senegalese designer NuNu of Banu Design and her all-women atelier to give the Olympic Collection a new identity.

Natural dyes made from plants, locally sourced materials and traditional techniques. Every detail rooted in Senegalese craftsmanship.

More than a collection. A celebration of the women, creativity and culture behind it. 🌿
